title: Verified media location
responsibility: Names intact capture bytes by content hash and reports a gap when bytes are absent or differ from the record.

inputs.name: mediaPlace.bytes
inputs.description: The capture bytes whose SHA-256 digest is checked. If they are undefined, the supplied gap is returned.

inputs.name: mediaPlace.file
inputs.description: The record's media path and expected SHA-256 digest. A trailing alphanumeric extension is lowercased for the returned name; when none matches, the extension is bin.

inputs.name: mediaPlace.gap
inputs.description: The reason returned unchanged when bytes are missing or their computed SHA-256 digest differs from the recorded digest.
examples: Expected digest did not match the capture bytes.

outputs.name: mediaPlace
outputs.description: Returns media/<sha256>.<extension> when the supplied bytes hash to the recorded digest; otherwise returns media null with the supplied gap. It lowercases a trailing alphanumeric extension, falls back to bin, and performs no file reads or writes.

outputs.name: checkedMedia
outputs.description: An asynchronous MediaPlacer whose place method runs the same digest check for each capture and reports a location or gap without writing bytes.
